newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Oil and Gas spuds Ruby-1 well.
newsitem.headline: NZ Oil and Gas spuds Ruby-1 well.

text.p: New Zealand Oil and Gas said on Thursday its Ruby-1 exploration well in Western Australia spudded in at 5.30 p.m. (Western Australian Time) on Wednesday.
On Thursday at 6 a.m. the well was at 23 metres and drilling ahead.
Over the next 24 hours it was planned to drill to 33 metres, set conductor, then drill ahead to 130 metres where surface casing will be set.
Ruby-1 is in the southern part of licence EP110, around 15 kilometres south of the Tubridgi Gas Field.
It is a large structural-stratigraphic trap extending to some 30 kilometres square, with potential in the order of 40 million barrels of recoverable oil.
Total well depth is planned at 440 metres, and drilling should be completed within seven days.
Euro Pacific Energy Pty Ltd 7.5 percent
Hardman Oil and Gas Pty Ltd 3.3 percent
